svg.text: Ascent and Oramus te · LM-013A–LM-017A · spoken 1962 Low Mass, two servers

g.text: The priest rises from the prayers at the foot
priest: standing · plano-centre · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
AC1: kneeling-erect · plano-epistle · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast

“Oramus te, Domine, per merita Sanctorum tuorum, quorum reliquiae hic sunt, et
omnium Sanctorum: ut indulgere digneris omnia peccata mea. Amen.” (secret)
